_comment: REGRESSION SCENARIO: a long single-channel run with throttle steps, to catch problems that only show over minutes (memory growth, a gap that appears late, telemetry drifting out of sync). Channel 1 bidirectional at 100, 200, then 300; channels 2-4 idle. Thresholds sit well below what this bench delivers: about 255 records/s with one bidirectional motor and 225/s with two (Core 0 samples the latest capture, so this is a sampling rate, not the reply rate), a largest gap of 15ms typically and up to 62ms when the SD card flushes, and every sampled decode CRC-valid.
